title: Evacuation Order for zone SON-3A, Ridgeview Fire
body:
An Evacuation Order is now in effect for zone SON-3A near the Ridgeview Fire. Zone SON-3A covers Ridgeview Road from Highway 12 to Bennett Valley Road. People in zone SON-3A must leave now.

The Evacuation Warning remains in effect for zone SON-3B, the Matanzas Creek area. Be ready to leave.

To find your zone, use the county zone lookup at the official county website. This is fictional demo data.
instructions: If you are in zone SON-3A, leave now. Go to an open shelter or stay with friends or family outside the area.
